task.title: Resume safely stopped task budgets without resetting effort
task.goal:
## Outcome and ownership

A safely completed failed or cancelled task can now be explicitly resumed through `task-budget-resume`, retaining its original deadline, spent effort, repetition history and old attempts. Resume dispatches nothing. Unknown/active work, stale digests, expired/exhausted budgets, changed estate configuration and closed tasks remain denied. Old attempt IDs remain non-replayable; a new attempt undergoes ordinary authorization and admission.

Driver: active SWAG engineering session. Alpha project-to-learning prerequisite; Gate G-01b/G-02a / POAM-009. Depends on #206, #222 and #229. Keep draft until dependency landing, installed acceptance and its own candidate CI. No gate/version/release completion is claimed.

## Scope and boundary

The branch starts at main `df26b355` and ordinarily composes #229 at `d5151eef`; baseline merge `ec681d92` has the exact worker tree. The original PR brief preceded new implementation. Review the resume delta from that baseline. Implementation revision: `6a4cbb042a13f5a7c41b53d11d62b54a85df3bed`.

The existing engine budget transaction owns recovery and compares current budget/session/security bytes plus the runtime cursor. No new lifecycle store, lease clearing, budget reset or provider policy is added. The contract catalogue owns HTTP/schema/SDK projections; native carriage sends once and validates the response. A lost acknowledgement requires budget readback, not automatic retry.

Authored changes cover the budget contract/engine, HTTP dispatch, native validation and engine/native tests. Mechanical changes cover SDK/OpenAPI projections, advertised digest, corpus endpoint count, reference citations and navigation. Unknown-outcome reconciliation, UI recovery controls, project effects and model/release qualification remain outside this package.

## Evidence and review

[Package journal](https://github.com/rrflow/rrflow-development/blob/6a4cbb042a13f5a7c41b53d11d62b54a85df3bed/docs/evidence/change-journals/gate-g/task-budget-resume.md) records owner/source inspection, before/after behavior, exact commands, failures, hashes and limits.

- Ten focused worker/recovery tests and real authenticated HTTP resume/next-step proof pass.
- Engine suite: 364 passed, four existing ignored before the advertised schema-digest correction; six bootstrap checks pass afterward. Runtime resume code is unchanged.
- All 189 contract/client tests and all 33 server tests pass. The server suite required the same controller helper build as CI.
- Strict all-target/all-feature Clippy, Rust formatting, all five SDK generators, 73-operation schema parity, TypeScript lint/types/six tests and repository checks pass.
- Retained failures: stale corpus endpoint count; stale advertised OpenAPI digest; missing CI controller fixture; redundant test conversion; local SDK tool/encoding setup. No assertions were weakened or failed observations replaced.

No external algorithm or dependency change was needed. Existing authority/control audit owns tracing; no performance/resource or model-quality claim is made. Stop conditions remain clearing unknown work, resetting budgets, mutating old attempts, bypassing authority or expanding into automatic reconciliation.

The canonical clean-source primary is now frozen locally: 154,068,480 bytes, SHA-256 `d4cc99d8527b97ba145023e0b1cc4a7c26a0682f6edc8c2d5d8d9ff1ad4ffec0`, with `engine-frozen.json` under SWAG `.swag/evidence/20261031/task-budget-resume/`. Its captured/reproduced compilation closure, copied executable digest and clean source/version report pass verification. It is unsigned, unoptimized and excludes model weights; no installed resume trial is claimed.

Next: prove public recovery plus separately authorized new BF16 work on the same actual task, retaining effort/deadline across restart. Then compose the exact SDK/engine into Connectome. Prior binaries and provider trials do not inherit this capability.
